---
title: "API examples"
description: "Explore MGnify studies, analyses and results with Python and R."
---

Find a study, list its analyses, and load a Pfam result into a data frame.
Choose an example to get started:

- [Python with requests and pandas](python.qmd) — edit and run in your browser.
- [R with jsonlite](r.qmd) — edit and run in your browser.
- [Observable JS with D3](observable-js.qmd) — plot Antismash cluster counts for an analysis.
- [Python with MGnipy](mgnipy.qmd) — a quick introduction and an interactive demo.
- [MGnify Proteins API in Python](proteins-api.qmd) — look up proteins, search by biome or Pfam, and build a FASTA file.

- [Download analyses as CSV](download-csv.qmd) — save a study’s analyses to your computer.
- [Map AtlantECO samples](atlanteco_samples_map.qmd) — explore sample locations in Python.
- [Pathways Explorer in R](pathways.qmd) — explore module completeness and detected functions.

The introductory Python and R examples start with [an Antarctic soil assembly study](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/metagenomics/studies/MGYS00010393/overview),
but can be used with any public MGnify study.
